name: claude-voice-skills
description: Three Claude Code skills for building voice agents with OpenAI's May 2026 Realtime API: conversational voicebots (gpt-realtime-2), live translation (gpt-realtime-translate), and streaming transcription (gpt-realtime-whisper). Includes runnable TypeScript and Python examples for SIP/Twilio, WhatsApp, Web/WebRTC, mobile, and meeting bots.
